workspaces:
CREATE TABLE `workspaces` (
  `workspace_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `display_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `group_name` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `node_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `owner_type` enum('PERSONAL','ORGANIZATION') NOT NULL,
  `owner_user_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `owner_organization_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `registered_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`workspace_id`),
  KEY `workspaces_owner_user_fk` (`owner_user_id`),
  KEY `workspaces_owner_org_fk` (`owner_organization_id`),
  KEY `workspaces_node_idx` (`node_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `workspaces_node_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`node_id`) REFERENCES `nodes` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `workspaces_owner_user_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `workspaces_exact_owner` CHECK ((((`owner_type` = _utf8mb4'PERSONAL') and (`owner_user_id` is not null) and (`owner_organization_id` is null)) or ((`owner_type` = _utf8mb4'ORGANIZATION') and (`owner_user_id` is null) and (`owner_organization_id` is not null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
